Common Questions

Before we
speak

Answers to the questions most prospective clients ask before reaching out.

Yes, entirely. We offer a no-obligation initial consultation to all qualified prospective clients. Our goal in that conversation is to understand your situation fully and tell you honestly whether we are the right fit — not to sell you on our services.
We typically work with clients who have investable assets of $500,000 or more. However, we evaluate each situation individually. If your circumstances are compelling and there is a clear path to a meaningful long-term relationship, we are willing to discuss options regardless of current asset levels.
RADIANX CAPITAL charges fees based on assets under management. We do not receive commissions, referral fees, or compensation from any third party. Our complete fee schedule is disclosed in our Form ADV, available upon request. We believe fee transparency is the foundation of a trustworthy advisory relationship.
SEC registration means RADIANX CAPITAL is registered as an investment adviser with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940. This subjects us to ongoing regulatory oversight, disclosure requirements, and — most importantly — a legal fiduciary duty to act in the best interest of our clients at all times.
We respond to all enquiries within one business day. For urgent matters, please call us directly at (646) 403-3807. We treat every enquiry with complete confidentiality.
Yes. While our office is based in New York, we serve clients across the United States. We are registered in all required states and are fully equipped to manage client relationships remotely through secure digital channels and regular communication.
